Test: test_create_engine_does_not_raise_operational_error
Counterexample URL: "sqlite:///./data/test.db"
Failure: sqlalchemy.exc.OperationalError: (sqlite3.OperationalError) unable to open database file
SQLAlchemy expanded the relative URL to the correct tmp_path-relative path but the directory was never created by _ensure_sqlite_dir, so SQLite cannot open the file.

Root cause documented: urlparse("sqlite:///./data/test.db").path == "/./data/test.db" — the leading "/" makes the path look non-relative. On Windows, Path("/./data/test.db").is_absolute() == False (no drive letter), but Path.cwd() / "/./data/test.db" still resolves outside tmp_path, so mkdir targets the wrong location regardless of platform.
